title: Fix env-sensitive tasks_cli test on tool-named worktree paths
goal: tests/tasks_cli.rs::the_tool_in_the_process_tree_names_the_agent fails whenever the checkout path contains a tool marker (devin/codex/cursor/...): the spawned susi sees the test-runner argv0 (<worktree>/target/debug/deps/tasks_cli-*) and the gate script path, both carrying the marker, so detect_agent resolves DEVIN instead of the SHAREDTOKEN fallback. Blocks cargo test --workspace and susi workflow finish for every tool-named worktree. Fix by matching markers on process basenames only, not full path text.
